snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.desc: Very long range; slow, heavy shots.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Speeds up the longer it runs.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: Spawns a decoy double on deploy.

snare.name: Snare
snare.desc: Web slows the units it hits.

rampage.name: Rampage
rampage.desc: Each kill makes it hit harder.

artillery.name: Artillery
artillery.desc: Lobs shells across the whole page.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.desc: Becomes a copy of its first foe.

roll.name: Roll
roll.desc: Curls up and bowls through a lane.

leap.name: Leap
leap.desc: Bounds over the river in one hop.

quill.name: Quillstorm
quill.desc: Fires a volley of quills on death.

molten.name: Molten
molten.desc: Leaves a burning trail behind it.

siphon.name: Siphon
siphon.desc: Heals when it damages a tower.

warp.name: Warp
warp.desc: Teleports to the nearest foe once.

echo.name: Echo
echo.desc: Its attacks strike a second time softly.

gale.name: Gale
gale.desc: Shoves nearby enemies back on spawn.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.desc: Grants bonus ink when it falls.

wildcard.desc: Summons a random generated unit; costs more each use.

builder.desc: Wanders to open ground and folds an extra tower troop; killing it tears the build down.

lanternfish.name: Lantern Fish
lanternfish.blurb: A cold light drifts up from the river.

papercutkite.name: Papercut Kite
papercutkite.blurb: Thin, fast, and unkind at the edges.

bastioram.name: Bastion Ram
bastioram.blurb: It does not stop. It does not turn.

embermoth.name: Ember Moth
embermoth.blurb: Drawn to the last warm light.

glasstortoise.name: Glass Tortoise
glasstortoise.blurb: You can see straight through its guard.

saltgolem.name: Salt Golem
saltgolem.blurb: Slow, patient, and hard to wash away.

reedcolony.name: Reed Colony
reedcolony.blurb: They rise wherever the water slows.

inkwren.name: Ink Wren
inkwren.blurb: A small dark note, singing across the page.

cinderhound.name: Cinder Hound
cinderhound.blurb: It runs the coals and does not slow.

marbleaegis.name: Marble Aegis
marbleaegis.blurb: A standing shield the enemy must answer.

willothewisp.name: Will-o-Wisp
willothewisp.blurb: Follow it and lose your footing.

inkling.name: Inkling
inkling.blurb: A single drop of ink, given legs.

papermoth.name: Paper Moth
papermoth.blurb: Barely there, and gone in a gust.

cinderling.name: Cinderling
cinderling.blurb: It burns brightest just before it's gone.

dustsprite.name: Dust Sprite
dustsprite.blurb: A mote that refuses to settle.

reedskiff.name: Reed Skiff
reedskiff.blurb: Rides the river's edge, light as a leaf.

thistleboar.name: Thistle Boar
thistleboar.blurb: Bristling and bad-tempered on a budget.

gullpair.name: Gull Pair
gullpair.blurb: Two sets of wings, one bad attitude.

hedgemage.name: Hedge Mage
hedgemage.blurb: A hedge-witch with a frostbitten wand.

beetlecart.name: Beetle Cart
beetlecart.blurb: Slow, low, and hard to shove.

emberwren.name: Ember Wren
emberwren.blurb: A small bird with a cinder in its chest.

mudcrab.name: Mud Crab
mudcrab.blurb: Sidles out of the shallows to pinch ankles.

sproutling.name: Sproutling
sproutling.blurb: A tiny standing sapling that heartens the line.

mole.name: Molewright
mole.blurb: Digs clean under the river and pops up behind the line.

eaglenest.name: Eagle's Nest
eaglenest.blurb: A crag fort that rains powder-kegs across the page, then crumbles.

beekeeper.name: The Beekeeper
beekeeper.blurb: A bear in a veil. Its hive looses bees — but they sip your ink.

bee.name: Bee
bee.blurb: A single bee from the keeper's hive.

wildcard.name: Wildcard
wildcard.blurb: Calls in something the binder never drafted. Costs +2 more each time you play it.

foldwright.name: The Foldwright
foldwright.blurb: Wanders your side seeking open ground, then folds a whole new tower troop from scratch. Slay it and the half-built structure tears apart.

foldknight.name: Fold Knight
foldknight.blurb: A tabard of pressed pleats, a blade of one clean crease.

inkwitch.name: Ink Witch
inkwitch.blurb: She folds the dark between the pages, and it holds her shape.

generation.note: Cards may be authored at runtime by ai_director.py and validated through sanitize_card() before entering play. The 'living' set marks generated cards; they are not persisted to this file.

model_recipes.note: Cards may carry an optional 'model' array: an origami recipe of known-good fold parts rendered on the field. Validated via origami.fold_sanitize(); cosmetic only.
